about: Corrections to fields of data/catalog/sc_catalog.json. harvest/catalog.py applies them on every build (python -m harvest.catalog; --apply-corrections re-applies them offline). Each entry gives the record id, the field, its old value as harvested, the corrected value and the reason; inferred marks a correction that is a judgment rather than read from a source. A correction applies only while the record still holds the old value. Records are never deleted here (see catalog_exclude.json).
